title: Why A $843 Million Tug Will End The ISS
hook: A $843 Million Tug Will Push The ISS To Earth
closing: Ending the station safely matters to everyone living beneath its final path.
question: Should the ISS be replaced?

segments.say: The ISS has hosted crews continuously for 24 years, making its planned ending feel almost unthinkable.
The ISS cost about $150 billion, so disposal must protect people as carefully as construction did.
NASA's deorbit tug costs $843 million, because the station cannot be left to fall wherever gravity chooses.
